cohort: 38 cases of Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) diagnosed beyond 28 weeks of gestation from a single tertiary care center in South India were studied.
finding: The study found advanced maternal age, previous Cesarean section, and placenta previa to be major risk factors for PAS, with massive obstetric hemorrhage as the commonest maternal complication and prematurity and low birth weight as key perinatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Previous Cesarean section was identified as a major risk factor for Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS).
